digest.component_or_area: CLI dispatch layer and command warning system
propositions: Single-ticket CLI commands (show, comment, edit, transition, reopen, tag, untag, set-file-impact, deps, archive, check-ac, clarity-check, link, unlink) must emit a WARN line to stderr when another session holds the target ticket, without altering stdout or exit code.
Bulk-read commands (list, search, ready, next-batch) and create must never emit a cross-session warning, regardless of ticket holder state.
The allowlist of warned commands must be defined as an explicit frozenset in the CLI dispatch layer keyed by command spellings from _CORE_FACTORIES, not inferred by convention.
The warning emit must be best-effort and never gate the underlying operation: exceptions from cross_session_warning_for must be swallowed and the command proceeds normally unwarned.
For link and unlink (multi-endpoint commands), the warning is computed only for the primary ticket argument (id1).
The warning is computed from ticket state at operation time (before mutations apply), so transitions and mutations show the holder before the operation clears it.
